name: PB Metal
description: Since 2010, PB Metal Fab, employee-owned and operated, has established itself as a premier provider of high-quality parts and metal fabrication services across the Midwestern states, committed to delivering cost-effective, prompt, and reliable solutions tailored to our clients' needs. As a full-service metal processing job shop, our core equipment includes state-of-the-art flat-sheet lasers, tube lasers, and advanced forming, rolling, welding, machining, and finishing tools, enabling us to streamline processes such as fabrication, assembly, and more under one roof. Over the years, we have invested in cutting-edge technology, including automated material storage systems that significantly enhance our productivity. Our continuous growth led to the construction of a new 40,000-square-foot facility in 2012, and with an expansion of 67,000 square feet in 2024, our total manufacturing space now totals 110,000 square feet. This expansion allows us to better serve increasing market demands while maintaining our core focus—being entirely customer-driven to meet and exceed client expectations.
